name: Fiend Cultist

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke
headerEntries: The cultist casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three Pact Axe attacks.

action.name: Pact Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Fire damage.

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

fluffEntries: Fiend Cultist: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 11 para o modo fatal.
